_comment: Copy to main.parameters.json (gitignored) and fill in. Secrets are @secure() — never commit real values; the file below carries placeholders only. Globally-unique names (ACR, storage) must be changed. Foundry values come from the EXISTING resource you are reusing (Sweden Central).

parameters._comment_images: backendImage/frontendImage are OMITTED on purpose. deploy-app.yml owns the running image; an empty (unset) image param means the infra template PRESERVES the currently-running image, so re-applying infra is idempotent and never resets the app to a placeholder. Set them (to a real ACR tag) ONLY on first-create or the env delete+recreate, when no running app exists to preserve.
parameters._comment_clientBundle: clientBundleBlob is the blob name of the uploaded private client bundle zip (e.g. 'rfcsm-bundle.zip'). Empty → public-demo mode (generic bank only). Set it here (idempotent param, flows to CLIENT_BUNDLE_BLOB) after uploading the bundle from inside the VNet — prefer this over a manual `az containerapp update --set-env-vars`, so the value survives every infra re-apply. Requires the VNet + blob private endpoint (this template) to actually reach the blob at boot.
parameters._comment_models: Project default gpt-5-mini for both; second choice gpt-4.1-mini. foundryAgentModel must be a chat deployment that exists on your Foundry resource. voiceLiveDefaultModel must be a model Voice Live hosts natively in your region (Learn: Speech regions → Voice Live tab); gpt-5.6-luna/sol, gpt-5.4-mini and gpt-6-* are rejected on swedencentral.
parameters._comment_immutable: Set githubOwnerId/githubRepoId only if GitHub presents the immutable-ID OIDC subject (repo:owner@<id>/repo@<id>:ref:...); Azure Login fails AADSTS700213 otherwise. Look up: gh api /repos/<owner>/<repo> --jq '{owner:.owner.id, repo:.id}'.
